name: Gaussian Splatting Photometric Stereo
definition: A method for calibrated photometric stereo that uses 3D Gaussian Splatting to estimate surface normals and albedo by optimizing Gaussian parameters (position, covariance, color, opacity) to minimize a loss function combining photometric error and normal alignment.
summary: Gaussian Splatting Photometric Stereo estimates surface normals and albedo by optimizing 3D Gaussian parameters to minimize photometric and normal alignment losses, offering interpretability through explicit physical modeling rather than neural networks.
